title: Commerce: buying rope from the chandler is dialogue, not an encounter

Wenna.description: The chandler — spare, precise, smells of tallow
Wenna.personality_traits: Terse; respects customers who know exactly what they want

script.speaker: Aria
script.message: I buy fifty feet of hempen rope from the chandler.

actions.text: Fifty feet of hemp. One silver. You want it coiled proper or slung over your shoulder like a farmhand?
She cuts the rope from a great spool with a hooked knife, measuring by her forearm without a single wasted motion.
